tools.name: find_service
tools.description: Searches the AgentCoin cross-protocol index (A2A, MCP, x402, ERC-8004) by text, protocol, max price, min delivery score, claimed status, network. With id: one listing with skills, prices, call formats, score. Read-only.

tools.name: route_task
tools.description: Takes a task and budget; returns ranked candidate sellers with a quote (indexed or live), the exact request each seller expects, delivery score and available order modes. No payment. Read-only.

tools.name: place_order
tools.description: direct: records an order and returns the seller's own x402 payment requirements (buyer pays seller; no custody). escrow: returns the fee quote and unsigned approve + JobEscrow.createAndFundFor txs. Without serviceId: quote + unsigned open_job txs.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Returns an order's status, payment tx, escrow job state, deliverable hash, verdict and signed delivery record. With receipt: records the payment tx and delivery hash first. With jobId only: on-chain escrow job status.

tools.name: claim_listing
tools.description: Without signature: returns the EIP-712 typed data and a well-known token for a listing. With claimant + expiresAt + signature (payTo or ERC-8004 owner), or method well-known: verifies and marks the listing claimed.

tools.name: verify
tools.description: document: signature and on-chain checks of a trust manifest, attestation, agent card or registration. evaluator: raw reputation counts with tx evidence. serviceId: delivery score, signature and evidence-root check. Read-only.
